text:
so here is where it gets weird and how u solve it while just passing the weird effect since idk what to say really

but if i place a floor under a staircase but there is no floor leading up to it, meaning i have to clear from the ground a floor + the first step, u would think, thats not going to happen. yet it works fine. 

this quirk helps because

all stairs need to be placed with a floor underneath, that solves the problem all the time. if there is a floor there, then it just places normally, if no floor, include a floor under the stairs first
resolution: The stair/floor weirdness is resolved without needing the floor-under-stairs auto-placement: the actual blocker was the invisible stair boundary walls (removed in 92690b54c), plus the step-height crest fix and walls-rest-on-floors. Stairs now collide as their visible slope. If the user still wants auto-floor-under-stairs as an authoring nicety, that remains an optional follow-up, but it is no longer required for stairs to work.
